fees.note: Single-trip basic fee $20 covers oversize, overweight or both (valid 5 days). If the load is also overweight the $20 is shown on the overweight line instead. Superloads pay the same fees.
Single-trip basic fee $20 (one permit covers weight and dimensions).
Overweight fee $0.04 per ton-mile. The rule does not state whether tons are excess or gross weight - excess over legal assumed; VERIFY (gross basis would be several times higher).

When low-impact bridge monitors are assigned: $150 first bridge, $100 second, $50 each additional, max $750. Superloads (>120,000 lb) need bridge analysis; bridge strengthening, professional analysis charges or a bond may be required.

restrictions.text: Sunrise to sunset only. Up to 14 ft wide: seven days a week (not on holidays/holiday weekends). Over 14 ft wide (and other loads exceeding Turnpike weekend limits): Monday-Friday only.
Loads over 16 ft wide move only Sunday morning until noon; escorts as specified on the permit.
No travel on legal holidays or holiday weekends (WV Code 2-2-1; WVDOH publishes yearly high-travel-day and event closures, e.g. WVU home football days in Monongalia/Marion/Harrison/Preston counties).
No travel on legal holidays or holiday weekends. Overweight-only loads up to 135,000 lb (110,000 lb on the WV Turnpike) may otherwise travel 24/7 when requested.

Escorted loads: no travel on two-lane highways Mon-Fri 7-9 AM and 2:30-4 PM during the school year; Charleston area (I-64 Exit 39-85, I-77 Exit 85-106, US119 Ruth-I-64, within 5 mi of city) 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM during DST, 9 AM-4 PM only during EST.
WV Turnpike: 14'1"-18' wide sunrise-sunset Mon-Thu; 18'1"-24'6" wide Sundays before noon only; over 24'7" limited by toll plazas.

notes: Single-trip limits: 16 ft wide, 120,000 lb gross, 28,000 single / 45,000 tandem / 50,000 tri / 55,000 quad axle; height and length limited by route. Anything beyond is a superload (same fee, bridge analysis).
Max overhang on any permit: 15 ft front, 30 ft rear.
Police escort: DOH decides for houses or similar large structures that significantly disrupt traffic; applicant must arrange it with local law enforcement (no numeric trigger).

Escort thresholds use the WVDOH table: width ranges start at 10'6", 12'1", 14'1", 15'1"; length at 75', 95'1", 100'1". Districts and the Parkway Authority may require more escorts. 4-lane non-Interstate at 15'1"-16' needs 1 front + 2 rear (non_interstate here uses the 2-lane 2 front + 1 rear; same vehicle count). On Interstate at 15'1"-16' the table says 2 rear only, but the 14'1" rule's front escort still matches here (engine takes max), so 1 front is over-counted.
157CSR5 text cited is the 2026 proposed amendment; confirm the adopted version.
